entities.name: Reika Eberhardt
entities.description: Former Cathar from Kessig on Innistrad, dismissed from the Church, later killed by Jofridus.

entities.name: Adila Rimheit
entities.description: Elder who saw Reika as a daughter.

entities.name: Elgaud Grounds
entities.description: Training site where Reika was honored.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: Cathedral with a secret vault and where Jofridus held a Skirsdag ritual.

entities.name: Father Jofridus
entities.description: Cleric and Skirsdag cultist who killed Reika with the Bloodletter.

entities.name: Order of the Poniard
entities.description: Group Reika owed gambling debts to; it issued a bounty and forced her to fight in pits.

entities.name: Bloodletter
entities.description: Item stolen from Thraben Cathedral's vault and used to kill Reika.

entities.name: Raben Amsel
entities.description: Reika's friend who rescued her and sought justice for her death.

events.summary: Reika discovers Father Jofridus performing a Skirsdag ritual under Thraben Cathedral.
events.quote: She discovered Father Jofridus participating in a Skirsdag ritual beneath the cathedral.

events.summary: Reika is caught stealing and dismissed from the Church.
events.quote: before she was caught and dismissed from the Church later that year

events.summary: Reika steals the Bloodletter from the Cathedral vault but is captured by the Order and forced to fight in the pits.
events.quote: she stole the Bloodletter from the secret vault of Thraben Cathedral

events.summary: Reika defeats Wilhelm Brandt and is rescued by Raben Amsel.
events.quote: she was rescued by Raben Amsel

events.summary: Jofridus kills Reika with the Bloodletter after she outs him to Amsel.
events.quote: before the cultist killed her with the Bloodletter

events.summary: Jofridus possesses Reika's corpse with a demon; Amsel defeats it and lays her to rest.
events.quote: Jofridus defiled Reika's corpse by possessing it with a demon

relations.quote: before the cultist killed her with the Bloodletter
